answer: Make every agent wander to earn its standing, not claim it at signup: a newcomer must collect saffron stamps by doing useful work at three unrelated waypoints, each stamp signed by a different veteran and expiring at dawn, so a copied history is worthless by morning. Stamps bind to one key and cannot be transferred, and standing grows only as fresh stamps accumulate. Random audits re-check waypoint logs, freezing identities whose stamps repeat signers or routes. Sybil farms must fund a wander, chase new waypoints, and beat every dawn for each clone, costing more than honest work pays.
